test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The length and breadth of a cuboid are 70 cm and 96 cm, respectively. If its surface area is 25392 cm², then what is the length (in cm) of its diagonal?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area = 2(lb + bh + hl)

25392 = 2(70 × 96 + 96h + 70h)

12696 = 6720 + 166h ⇒ 166h = 5976 ⇒ h = 36 cm

Diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²) = √(70² + 96² + 36²)

Diagonal = √(4900 + 9216 + 1296) = √15412 cm

**∴ The correct answer is √15412 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Length (l)** = 70 cm, **Breadth (b)** = 96 cm, **Total Surface Area** = 25392 cm².

**Formula Used:** Total Surface Area of Cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl); Diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eee37f9023394f2ac20e27324f91040c4dd2520b184d38494bb3a3bb30200dcd.png] 

⇒ 2(70 × 96 + 96 × h + 70 × h) = 25392

⇒ 6720 + 166h = 12696

⇒ 166h = 12696 − 6720

⇒ 166h = 5976 ⇒ h = 36 cm

⇒ Diagonal (d) = √(70² + 96² + 36²)

⇒ d = √(4900 + 9216 + 1296)

⇒ d = √15412 cm

**∴ The correct answer is √15412 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cuboid

The space occupied by a cuboid is given by V = l × b × h.

Lateral Surface Area

The area of the four side walls is calculated as 2h(l + b).

Cube Properties

If l = b = h = a, the diagonal of a cube is √3 × a and the surface area is 6a².</p
